review_type: Independent prospective source/contract/firewall review before model outcomes
checks: Exact frozen full phase-I architecture, SHA256-bound strict weight load, no random fallback, inference mode and nontrainable weights.
Allowed training chromosomes and chr7 sequence fetching only; exact 2001bp geometry, raw-sequence hash and encoded RC-canonical identity checks.
Independent network calls for forward and nucleotide-RC onehot sequences before the phase-I 4560-dimensional output; no representation-axis reversal.
Exact phase-II architecture, Adadelta parameters, unweighted BCE, batch256, max50, patience15, no mixed precision or JIT.
Fixed seeds, distinct epoch shuffle/orientation RNG streams, one Bernoulli0.5 orientation per genomic row before applying permutation.
Native configuration-specific chr7 checkpoint-role symmetric BCE only; strict-decrease updates imply earliest minimum; selected trainable and BN weights restored and serialized.
No completed fit may run again; infrastructure-only retries preserve seed/procedure and require append-only authorization records.

All18 checkpoints must be frozen before actual chr7 union inference; saved models rerun with swapped nucleotide cache orientations, reversed row order and changed batch size for genuine invariance testing.
All18 seed and six ensemble RC gates use atol=rtol=1e-6 and finite bounded probabilities; fixed-order equal-three-seed float64 aggregation.
Identical frozen C-task chr7 selection panels across A/B/C; paired component bootstrap, own-replicate prevalence AP gain and Brier skill, strict lower95 null gates, sample seed SD with ddof1.
A/B comparisons diagnostic only; both C contexts must pass all gates before negative-only dedicated chr7 calibration and no fallback.

Calibration bound to same six C checkpoints, symmetric implementation, passed decision and prediction hashes; conservative nextafter formula, exact hex/17g serialization, no tie splitting or clipping above1.
No chr8-9, external benchmark, candidate scoring, allele-delta cutoff, fine-mapping or target-gene execution included.
software_note: Normative frozen CPython3.13.0/TF2.20.0/Keras3.14.1/NumPy2.5.0 is required. Accessible CPython3.13.0 reusing historical read-only site-packages is consistent; the inaccessible historical interpreter symlink and differing mutable pyvenv.cfg patch-version metadata must remain documented.
limitations: Source review and synthetic tests do not establish trained-model performance or substitute for postexecution cache/checkpoint/prediction/invariance/metric/calibration validation.
